## Hypothesis

The hypothesis was that adjusting the sniper strategy parameters (vol_mult, body_min_cents, min_stars, strike_offset, proximity_dollars, require_break_above_open, premium_stop_pct, tp1_premium_pct, tp1_qty_fraction, runner_target_pct, profit_lock_threshold_pct, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, qty) would improve edge capture on J's anchor days and overall P&L. However, the resulting strategy shows negative edge_capture and negative wide_pnl, indicating the hypothesis was not supported.

## Mechanism

Entry: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK with vol_mult=1.1, body_min_cents=0.02, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2 (OTM-2 puts), proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true.  
Exit: premium_stop_pct=-0.1 (10% stop), tp1_premium_pct=0.5 (50% TP1 selling half), tp1_qty_fraction=0.5, runner_target_pct=2.0 (200% target for runner), profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05 (arm profit lock at 5% gain), profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05 (trail stop at 5% below high water mark).
